propositions: Closing a bug ticket leaves the CLI process hanging for minutes after the close commits durably, due to unbounded O(commits × tickets) alias scanning in derive_caused_by during caused-by resolution.

Unrelated short four-hex commit-subject fragments are treated as ticket references and produce repeated 'Ambiguous prefix' terminal errors during post-close derive_caused_by, even though the close itself succeeded.

The bug_id is resolved once per commit in _find_fixing_commit without memoization, and _scan_alias is invoked with no quiet flag, causing ~2137 commits × ~0.26s per unresolvable candidate ≈ 9 minutes of pure filesystem work after write-commit.

Four-hex bare fragments from commit subjects should not resolve as ticket references; the fix applies quiet=True at all scanner call sites, hoists loop-invariant bug_id resolution, adds memoization, and short-circuits on hex-shape forms that cannot match the target.
